<mxfile host="embed.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Traditional GC Marking Flow" id="0"> <mxGraphModel dx="978" dy="1498" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1400" pageHeight="400" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#7c2d12;" value="传统 GC 标记流程（访问对象头）" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="1320" x="40" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffedd5;strokeColor=#ea580c;fontColor=#7c2d12;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=14;" value="对象引用" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="200" x="60" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffedd5;strokeColor=#ea580c;fontColor=#7c2d12;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=14;" value="访问堆定位对象" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="220" x="380" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffedd5;strokeColor=#ea580c;fontColor=#7c2d12;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=14;" value="读取 Mark Word
检查标记位" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="240" x="720" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="5" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffedd5;strokeColor=#ea580c;fontColor=#7c2d12;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=14;" value="判断是否已标记" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="220" x="1080" y="160" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#ea580c;strokeWidth=2;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="3"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="3" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#ea580c;strokeWidth=2;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="4"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#ea580c;strokeWidth=2;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="5"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
